description: Header file defining the MPEG2TSExtractor class for parsing MPEG-2 Transport Stream files within Android's media framework. It declares methods for track management, metadata retrieval, and data parsing, along with internal data structures and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: MPEG2TSExtractor
classes.description: A class for extracting and parsing MPEG-2 Transport Stream data, providing track access, metadata, and synchronization functionalities.

methods.name: countTracks
methods.description: Returns the number of media tracks available in the stream.

methods.name: getTrack
methods.description: Retrieves a specific media track by index.

methods.name: getTrackMetaData
methods.description: Obtains metadata for a specific track.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the extractor.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the extractor, setting up internal state.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Adds a new data source for parsing.

methods.name: feedMore
methods.description: Feeds additional data from source to parser, handling errors and end-of-stream conditions.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified timestamp in the stream.

methods.name: feedUntilBufferAvailable
methods.description: Feeds data until buffer is available for processing.

methods.name: findIndexOfSource
methods.description: Finds the index of a given data source.

methods.name: addSyncPoint_l
methods.description: Adds a synchronization point based on a parser event.

methods.name: estimateDurationsFromTimesUsAtEnd
methods.description: Estimates stream durations based on timestamps.
